items.name: rail-sidebar
items.title: Rail sidebar
items.description: Two-layer app sidebar: an icon rail for sections and a panel for that section's navigation. Built on the host shadcn sidebar, including its mobile sheet.

meta.descriptionEs: Riel de iconos y panel con la navegación de la sección elegida. En móvil se abre en la hoja del sidebar de shadcn.

examples.title: Estudio Lumen Field
examples.description: Secciones, grupos plegables, buscador y ficha de persona.

examples.title: Estrés
examples.description: Textos largos, RTL, muchas entradas y un contenedor de 320px.

meta.usage:
<RailSidebar
  sections={sections}
  value={section}
  onValueChange={setSection}
  activeHref={pathname}
  onNavigate={setPathname}
  onOpenCommand={openPalette}
  workspace={workspace}
  user={user}
>
  {children}
</RailSidebar>

api.name: sections
api.description: Rail entries. Each has id, icon, label, optional badge, placement, and nav groups.

api.name: value / defaultValue / onValueChange
api.description: Active rail section. Uncontrolled when value is omitted.

api.name: activeHref
api.description: Current page. Matching links set aria-current="page".

api.name: renderLink / asChild
api.description: Router-agnostic link. renderLink receives href, className, and children. asChild takes one element.

api.name: onNavigate
api.description: Called instead of following the href when the host owns routing.

api.name: workspace
api.description: Switcher card. options open a dropdown.

api.name: user / footerSlot
api.description: Footer card. footerSlot is the dropdown body.

api.name: onSearch / onOpenCommand
api.description: Search field and ⌘K. No command palette is built in.

api.name: collapsible
api.description: icon keeps the rail and hides the panel. Default icon.

api.name: contained
api.description: In-flow layout for a narrow container. The shell uses the shadcn sidebar.

api.name: className and slot classes
api.description: className, railClassName, panelClassName, itemClassName, groupClassName, headerClassName, footerClassName, searchClassName, insetClassName.

items.docs: Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite sidebar, avatar, tooltip, dropdown-menu, badge, input, or button. Behavior is inspired by the Sakani design system; no code or assets were copied. See NOTICE.

items.title: Adaptive table
items.description: Grouped table that drops, folds, and stretches columns to its container width. For a narrow panel. data-table is the full TanStack table; crm-table is a fixed contact layout.

meta.descriptionEs: Tabla agrupada que oculta, pliega y estira columnas según el ancho del contenedor. Para listas dentro de un panel, no para una tabla TanStack completa.

examples.title: Pipeline
examples.description: Contenedor con borde arrastrable y anchos fijos de 320, 480, 720 y 1100.

examples.title: Estrés
examples.description: Vacío, textos largos, números, RTL y carga.

meta.usage:
<AdaptiveTable
  title="Pipeline"
  locale={locale}
  columns={columns}
  groups={groups}
  getRowId={(row) => row.id}
  onRowClick={openRow}
  collapsibleGroups
/>

api.name: columns
api.description: priority (lower drops first), minWidth, mergeInto, render, compactRender, textValue, and header icon plus label.

api.name: groups
api.description: id, label, icon, and rows. The first group header carries the column icons.

api.name: onRowClick
api.description: Click and Enter or Space on the row.

api.name: collapsibleGroups
api.description: Group headers can hide their rows.

api.name: emptyState / loading
api.description: Empty copy and a loading status.

api.name: locale
api.description: Language of the table. Format money with formatAdaptiveNumber.

api.name: className and slot classes
api.description: className, tableClassName, headerClassName, groupClassName, rowClassName, cellClassName.

items.docs: Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite badge or button. Hidden columns are removed from the table, not visually hidden. Folded values stay in the target cell's text. Motion is a 200ms ease-out FLIP and is skipped when the reader prefers reduced motion. data-table remains the piece for full TanStack tables.

items.name: presence
items.title: Presence
items.description: Provider-agnostic presence types, an in-memory adapter, and hooks for others, self, updates, and a debounced typing flag.

meta.descriptionEs: Tipos, adaptador en memoria y hooks de presencia. La interfaz no depende de Liveblocks ni de Supabase.

examples.title: Sala simulada
examples.description: Tres personas y un agente. El cableado de Liveblocks y Supabase se muestra, no se conecta.

examples.title: Estrés
examples.description: Cero personas, nombres largos y una sala de 40.

api.name: PresenceUser
api.description: connectionId, userId, presence, info, and isAgent.

api.name: createMemoryPresence
api.description: In-memory adapter with join, update, and remove for demos and tests.

api.name: PresenceProvider
api.description: Subscribes to an adapter and provides the hooks.

api.name: useOthers / useSelf / useUpdateMyPresence
api.description: Read the room and publish a partial presence patch.

api.name: useTypingPresence
api.description: Sets a boolean key immediately and clears it after idleMs (default 1000).

items.docs: The setup guide ships as registry/lib/presence/README.md. UI pieces only read these hooks, so they work with the memory, Liveblocks, or Supabase adapter.

meta.descriptionEs: Adaptador de una sala Liveblocks. Los agentes son usuarios cuyo id empieza por agent-.

examples.title: Mapeo

examples.title: Estrés
examples.description: Cero, uno y cuarenta usuarios mapeados.

api.name: useLiveblocksPresenceAdapter
api.description: Maps useOthers, useSelf, and useUpdateMyPresence. Call it inside RoomProvider.

api.name: mapLiveblocksPresence
api.description: Pure mapping used by the hook. isAgent defaults to userId.startsWith("agent-").

items.docs: Apache-2.0 client SDKs only. Do not add @liveblocks/server or the liveblocks CLI (AGPL-3.0). Auth with @liveblocks/node stays in the host server. The Free plan needs visible Liveblocks branding and allows 10 connections per room. See registry/lib/presence/README.md.

items.name: presence-supabase
items.title: Supabase presence
items.description: Supabase Realtime Presence adapter. Tracks a channel and maps sync, join, and leave onto the shared presence hooks.

meta.descriptionEs: Adaptador de Supabase Realtime Presence. No obliga a usar Liveblocks.

examples.title: Canal

examples.title: Estrés
examples.description: Estado vacío, un usuario y cuarenta.

meta.usage:
const adapter = createSupabasePresence({
  supabase,
  room,
  presenceKey: userId,
  userId,
  info,
  initialPresence,
})

api.name: createSupabasePresence
api.description: channel(room, { config: { presence: { key } } }), track, and sync, join, and leave.

api.name: presenceKey / userId / info
api.description: Key for the channel and the local user payload.

items.docs: Enable Realtime and authorize the channel in the host project. Presence is not an authorization source. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite an existing Supabase client file; this item does not ship one.

api.description: Writes container-relative coordinates, throttled with requestAnimationFrame.
